definitions.short: David , the youngest son of Jesse
definitions.full: H1732. David דָּוִיד דָּוִד, 1066 proper name, masculine David , son of יִשַׂי , king of Israel, whose dynasty remained on the throne of Jerusalem till the Babylonian exile (compare 2Sam 7:11-15 etc.) ( beloved one ? compare Ba NB 189 ; according to Sayce Modern Rev. 1884, 158 ff.; Rel. Babylonian 53, 56 f. originally Dodo , title of sun-god worshipped in Israel compare דודה name of divinity among east Jordan Israelites MI 12 ) — דָּוִד always Ruth, Samuel, Kings (except 1Kin 3:14 ; 11:4 , 36 ) Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Isaiah, Jeremiah; also 1Chr 13:6 ; Ezek 34:24 ; 37:24-25 , (c. 790 t.); דָּוִיד always Zechariah, Chronicles (except 1Chr 13:6 ), Ezra, Nehemiah; also Amos 6:5 (where gloss according to Peters Hebraica. Apr. 1886, p. 175 ) 9:11 ; Hosea 3:5 ; Ezek 34:23 ; 1Kin 3:14 ; 11:4 , 36 ; Song 4:4 (c. 276 t.); — first named 1Sam 16:13 ; compare also Ruth 4:17 , 22 ; 2Sam 1:1 +, 1Kin 1:1 +, 2:1 +, etc. (see above); in titles of Psalm 3-9, 11-32, 34-41, 51-65, 68-70, 86, 101, 103, 108-110, 122, 124, 131, 133, 138-145 (73 in all); also in Psalm 18:51 (= 2Sam 22:51 ); 2Sam 72:20; 2Sam 89:36; 2Sam 89:50; 2Sam 122:5; 2Sam 132:1132:11; 132:17; ׳ד עַבְדִּי ( ׳י speaks) 3:18 ; 7:5 , 8 = 1Chr 17:4 , 7 compare 17:26 = 17:24 , also 1Kin 8:24-25 , 26 , 66 2Chr 6:15 ; 6:16 ; 6:17 ; 6:42 , 1Kin 11:13 ; 11:32 ; 11:34 ; 11:36 ; 11:38 ; 14:8 ; 2Kin 8:19 ; 19:34 = Isa 37:35 ; 2Kin 20:6 ; compare further Psa 18:1 ; 36:1 (both titles compare above) 78:70 ; 89:4 ; 89:21 ; 132:10 ; 144:10 ; Jer 33:21-22 , 26 ; so also as represented in coming (Messianic) ruler Ezek 34:23-24 , 37:24-25 , compare Hosea 3:5 ; Jer 30:9 (see עֶבֶד ). Phrases are: a. ד ׳עִיר (according to Sayce Mod.Rev.l.c. originally city of god Dod [o] ) = stronghold or citadel of Zion, 2Sam 5:7 , 9 = 1Chr 11:5 , 7 ; 2Sam 6:10 , 12 , 16 = 1Chr 13:13 ; 15:1 , 29 , compare Isa 22:9 ; especially of burial of kings 1Kin 2:10 ; 3:1 ; 8:1 2Chr 5:2 ; 1Kin 9:24 2Chr 8:11 ; 1Kin 11:27 11:43 2Chr 9:31 ; 1Kin 14:13 ; 15:8 2Chr 12:16 ; 2 Chronicles 13:23; 1Kin 15:24 2Chr 9:31 ; 1Kin 14:31 ; 15:8 2Chr 12:16 ; 2 Chronicles 13:23; 1Kin 15:24 2Chr 16:14 ; 1Kin 22:50 2Chr 21:1 ; 2Kin 8:24 2Chr 21:20 ; 2Kin 9:28 ; 2 Kings 12:22 2Chr 24:25 ; 2Kin 14:20 ; 15:7 , 15:38 2Chr 27:9 ; 2Kin 16:20 ; burial of Jehoiada 2Chr 24:16 ; further 32:5 , 30 ; 33:14 ; Neh 12:37 ; compare also ד חָנָה ׳קִרְיַת Isa 29:1 . b. ד ׳בֵּית 2Sam 3:1 , 6 + (compare בַּיִת 5c . c. ד ׳אֹהֶל Isa 16:5 (compare אֹהֶל 2 ). d. ד ׳סֻכַּת Amos 9:11 (compare סֻכָּה below סכך ). e. ד ׳כִּסֵּא 2Sam 3:10 compare 1Kin 1:37 ; 2:12 , 24 , 45 ; Isa 9:6 ; Jer 17:25 ; 22:2 , 30 ; 29:16 ; 36:30 ; compare 13:13 ; 22:4 , (compare also כִּסֵּא ). f. ד ׳קִבְרֵי Neh 3:16 compare 2Chr 32:33 בְנֵידֿ ׳קִבְרֵי (compare קֶבֶר ). g. ד ׳מִגְדַּל Song 4:4 . h. ד ׳כְּלֵישִֿׁיר האלהים אישׁ Neh 12:36 . i. ד ׳אֱלֹהֵי 2Kin 20:5 + (compare אֱלֹהִים 4b ). j. ד ׳חַסְדֵי 2Chr 6:42 ; Isa 55:3 (compare 2Sam 7:15 ; 1Kin 3:6 ; Psa 89:50 ; 2Chr 1:8 etc.). — (On text note the following: — דָּוִד 1Sam 30:20 a strike out ᵑ7 ᵐ5 We Dr; 2Sam 3:5 read probably name of a former husband of Eglah We Dr; 13:39 read רוּחַ We p.223 Dr; 2 Samuel 19:44 read בְּכוֺר (for בדוד ) ᵐ5 The We Dr; insert דָּוִד 9:11 ; 15:32 & 24:15 ᵐ5 We Dr; in 1Chr 18:12 ; Psa 60:1 אבשׁי & יואב are less original than דָּוִד 2Sam 8:13 We Dr).

Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Bethlehem Judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons. The man was an elderly old man in the days of Saul.
David was the youngest; and the three oldest followed Saul.
Now David went back and forth from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Bethlehem.

David left his baggage in the hand of the keeper of the baggage, and ran to the army, and came and greeted his brothers.
